articles.original_summary:
Toronto, Ontario – On November 2, the Honourable François-Philippe Champagne, Minister of Finance and National Revenue, will deliver remarks and participate in an armchair discussion hosted by the Canadian Club of Toronto. At the event, the Minister will highlight the government’s economic priorities ahead of Budget 2026, including its plan to build a stronger, more independent and resilient economy and make life more affordable for Canadians.

Ottawa, Ontario – Later on November 2, the Honourable François-Philippe Champagne, Minister of Finance and National Revenue, will similarly participate in a separate armchair discussion hosted by the Canadian Club of Ottawa, where he will speak to the government’s economic priorities and growth agenda.

articles.original_title: Minister Champagne to deliver economic addresses and participate in armchair discussions ahead of Budget 2026
articles.original_summary:
Toronto, Ontario – On November 2, the Honourable François-Philippe Champagne, Minister of Finance and National Revenue, will deliver remarks and participate in an armchair discussion hosted by the Canadian Club of Toronto. At the event, the Minister will highlight the government’s economic priorities ahead of Budget 2026, including its plan to build a stronger, more independent and resilient economy and make life more affordable for Canadians.

Ottawa, Ontario – Later on November 2, the Honourable François-Philippe Champagne, Minister of Finance and National Revenue, will similarly participate in a separate armchair discussion hosted by the Canadian Club of Ottawa, where he will speak to the government’s economic priorities and growth agenda.
